text:
Rashmi: Quick flag — can we stand up a tiny claim-queue for SI co-sell + HW bundles going into marketplace? Want low-friction: short TTL, one canonical CSV, and a daily adjudication window. @Noah @Lina
Noah: yes please. My ask: default TTL = 48h, extend to 7bd if SI marks tech_ownership=true. Keep headers minimal.
Lina: marketing timeline constraints: marketplace freeze = 5bd before publish, legal needs 72h on logos. Add `asset_clearance` column.
Arjun-SI: SI POV: if we ship a POC or PR we want an "ownership_badge" and CRM credit. Evidence = repo PR, demo recording with attendee list, or signed SOW.
Maya-Marketing: announcement cadence matters — if marketplace row has sku_lock=true we block open claims and surface to marketing for approval.
Rashmi: CSV headers idea (compact):
```
global_acct_id, acct_name, region, sales_owner, si_org, hw_vendor, claim_ts_utc, claim_ttl_days, tech_ownership, proof_url, ownership_badge, sku_lock, asset_clearance
```
Noah: ops automation can compute `confidence_pct` from domain/company-id dedupe and meeting metadata. Auto-resolve if >85 and only one high-confidence claim.
partner_ops_bot: scheduled job created: "si-claim-queue-dedupe" nightly 02:30 UTC — report: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-queue/2945003333 :robot_face:
Arjun-SI: adjudication flow proposal: 1) auto-resolve high-confidence, 2) if multiple tech_ownership=true open triage huddle, 3) otherwise first-claim wins. Keep manual escalations <36h.
Rashmi: pilot plan: 2-week pilot for the AcmeHardware bundle. Roles: Noah = manifest owner, Arjun-SI = SI evidence lead, Lina = marketing approvals, Rashmi = final arb. Daily adjudication slack post at 11:30 PT.
Noah: I'll post a sample CSV + two rows by EOD and wire the webhook to post diffs to #partnerships-review.
Lina: will prep a 1-pager for marketing/legal checklist.
Rashmi: great, thanks everyone. Aim is to avoid duplicate outreach and speed marketplace publishes. Ping me if you need different adjudication hours. :pray:
